title: The Origin and Mixed Faith of the Samaritans
description: The Assyrian king moved people from Babel, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim to the cities of Samaria. When lions attacked them because they did not fear the Lord, a priest taken captive was sent to Bethel to teach them the customs of the land. The peoples feared the Lord, but at the same time continued to worship their own gods such as Succoth-Benoth, Nergal, and Ashima—a mixed faith that endured.
